description: Fallow quality baseline. Counters may shrink but not grow; averageMaintainability may rise but not drop. Regenerate with `npm run check:quality -- --update` (commit the diff in the same PR that moves the metric). 2026-07-12: cloneGroups 36->35 and duplicatedLines 1048->1036 — extracted `useFileLink` (transcript/useFileLink.ts) to dedupe the vault-file-link decoration ToolCall.vue/ToolContentLines.vue/WriteEditView.vue each reimplemented, and `useToolNameSummary` (blocks/toolNameSummary.ts) to dedupe the `getToolName`/`getToolSummary` pair ToolCall.vue and SubagentToolItem.vue each recomputed (the clone group the file-link additions had grown); also collapsed a same-file duplicate tool-append loop in blockListViewModel.ts. Net improvement locks in below the prior baseline. 2026-07-12: complexFunctions 225->226 — the Codex PR#486 finished-turn fix adds one optional-chained `refreshTranscriptMessage?.()` branch to the already-complex `completeFinishedTurn` (InputController.ts), tipping it past the complexity threshold. The call is the minimal correctness fix (identity-refresh an interrupted/error/collapsed turn's in-place finalize); extracting to offset the branch would grow InputController past the LOC ceiling just re-locked in this same commit, so this is a deliberate reviewed +1, tied to the same fix as the loc-baseline bump.
